newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Commerce to up shares outstanding.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Commerce to up shares outstanding.

text.p: Bank of Commerce said on Monday that its shareholders have approved a plan to increase the number of authorized shares of common stock to 50 million from five million shares.

The plan allows the company to issue up to an additional 47.37 million shares of stock. Some 2.63 million shares have been issued or reserved for issuance upon conversion of preferred stock and exercise of warrants and stock options.
The company said in a statement that the move will make the bank better positioned to raise capital and make acquisitions, although none are planned at this time.

Bank of Commerce also said it will redeem its outstanding floating rate non-cumulative voting convertible Series B preferred stock. The Bank also declared a special dividend on the Series B preferred shares of 30.3 cents per share payable November 15, 1996 to shareholders of record October 31, 1996.
